locations.note: Navy diver Johnny Westland is on leave in Tahiti when he is pulled into a near-future oil crisis.
Westland is briefed at the Pentagon, learns that Stacy from Tahiti is an agent he must meet again, and ships out on the submarine USS Blackhawk.
The mission ends in Tunisia, where a kidnapped US ambassador must be rescued from terrorists.

routes.name: Cdr. Johnny Westland
routes.note: Called back from a Tahiti beach, Westland is briefed at the Pentagon and takes a submarine across hostile seas to free a kidnapped ambassador in Tunisia.
